rence/execution/call-a-tool.md): Executes a tool on the server and returns the MCP `CallToolResult` plus an additive `durationMs`
(wall-clock time of `executeTool`). Tool-level failures (`isError: true` in the result) are **successful calls** — the server answ
ered; only transport/auth errors use the error envelope.\n- [Render a prompt](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/rend
er-a-prompt.md): Renders a prompt with arguments and returns the MCP `GetPromptResult` directly (`description?`, `messages`).\n- [
Render an MCP App widget headlessly](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/render-an-mcp-app-widget-headlessly.md): Call
an MCP App tool and mount its `ui://` widget in real headless Chromium running the production host bridge, then report whether it
rendered, what it logged, what it was blocked from fetching, and the widget as an accessibility tree with addressable elements.\n
- [Create a retained widget session](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/create-a-retained-widget-session.md): Availab

p in one local Chromium context.…\n- [Read a retained widget snapshot](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/read-a-reta
ined-widget-snapshot.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires

urns an accessibility tree and addressable elements without replay…\n- [Act on a retained widget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refe
rence/execution/act-on-a-retained-widget.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments r

r and expires after its idle timeout. Runs one semantic action or assertion, using the same locator vocabul…\n- [Close a retained

nspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the o

e if no mat…\n- [List a suite's settings history](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/list-a-suites-settings-history
.md): One entry per committed edit to the suite's settings, newest first: who made it, which STORED fields moved, the note they le
ft, how many runs were launched against it, and the revision group that ties one request's writes together. Rows carry no configur
ation snapshots. Send a `revisionNumber` back…\n- [Attach one environment to a suite (atomic append)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-
reference/eval-suites/attach-one-environment-to-a-suite-atomic-append.md): APPEND one project environment to the suite's attachmen
ts, if it is not already there.\n- [List a server's accounts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/list-a-servers
-accounts.md): The accounts this server signs in with that you can see: your own personal accounts, or, on a server shared with th
e project, its project accounts. Another member's personal account never appears. METADATA ONLY: no account response carries a tok
en.\n- [Get a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/get-a-server-account.md): One account, by id o
r name. Another member's personal account answers `404`, the same as a missing one. A name two accounts share answers `409` with `
details.code: \"account_name_ambiguous\"` and both ids in `details.accountIds`.\n- [Upload tokens to a server account](https://doc
s.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/upload-tokens-to-a-server-account.md): Creates the account (`201`) or replaces its toke
n in place (`200`, same id). A well-formed account id never creates one: an unknown id is `404`. Any other reference is a name, an
d a name no account has creates the account.\n- [Delete a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/de
lete-a-server-account.md): Deletes the account and its stored token. The token's issuer is asked to revoke it where the issuer sup
ports revocation (best effort), which also invalidates any copy of the same token you hold.\n- [Rename a server account or make it
the default](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/rename-a-server-account-or-make-it-the-default.md): Rename the
account, make it the default, or both; a rename applies first. A name another account on the server uses answers `409` with `deta
ils.code: \"account_name_taken\"`.\n- [Import OAuth tokens](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/oauth/import-oauth-tokens.md): *
*Deprecated.** Use `PUT /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/accounts/{account}`. This route uploads to your default account o
n the server, creating an unnamed one when the server has none, and is removed 90 days after the accounts API shipped. Every answe
r carries `Deprecation: true`, a `Sunse…\n- [List GitHub Checks repositories](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/list-git
hub-checks-repositories.md): The repositories in this organization whose pull requests run an eval suite, plus the repositories th
e MCPJam GitHub App can reach (the choices a connect has).\n- [Run an eval suite on a repository's pull requests](https://docs.mcp
jam.com/api-reference/evals/run-an-eval-suite-on-a-repositorys-pull-requests.md): Connect a repository so every pull request to it
runs one eval suite and reports a GitHub check. **Affects everyone who opens a pull request on that repository**, and with `outag
ePolicy: fail_closed` it can block their merges.\n- [Request insights for an eval run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals
/request-insights-for-an-eval-run.md): **No credits are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the finished r
un and draws on the same shared `insightsPerDay` request ledger as swarm and user-testing insights.\n- [Grade an eval run with LLM
as Judge](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/grade-an-eval-run-with-llm-as-judge.md): **Spends.** Runs the goal-completi
on judge over the finished run, scoring each case's final answer against its expected output.\n- [Create a project](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/api-reference/projects/create-a-project.md): Creates a project in the caller's organization and responds `201` with its
detail. Requires organization membership and counts against the plan's `maxProjects` limit. Guest callers are denied.\n- [Delete a
project and everything scoped to it](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/delete-a-project-and-everything-scoped-to-it.
md): IRREVERSIBLE, and it cascades: project access grants and invites, the mapped workspace and its memberships, every saved serve
r in the project (each soft-deleted asynchronously, which also rotates the host configs that referenced it), and hosted tasks. Req
uires project admin. The request body must be…\n- [Update project metadata](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/update-
project-metadata.md): Updates name, description, icon or visibility. Requires project admin; a non-member gets `404` rather than `
